# Parameter mapping

<!-- Generated by experiments/check_params.py --markdown. Do not edit by hand. -->

## How equivalence is guaranteed

1. **One file for both stacks.** `config/slam_toolbox.yaml` is loaded unchanged by `ros1/launch/mapping.launch` (`rosparam load`) and `ros2/launch/mapping.launch.py` (passed to the node as a dict). `use_sim_time` is the only parameter the launch files add.
2. **Static check (CI).** `experiments/check_params.py` verifies every key is known, has the type slam_toolbox declares, and that GMapping values match their slam_toolbox counterparts.
3. **Runtime check (every run).** After the SLAM node starts, the runner dumps the parameters the node actually holds (`rosparam get` / `ros2 param dump`) into `effective_params.json` and fails the run if any value differs from the config. `metrics/compare_groups.py` then confirms the effective values are identical across all ROS1 and ROS2 runs.

## slam_toolbox (ROS1 Noetic and ROS2 Humble)

| Parameter | Type | Value | Controls |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | string | `mapping` | mapping or localization |
| `debug_logging` | bool | false | verbose solver logging |
| `enable_interactive_mode` | bool | false | interactive RViz markers (off: no extra load) |
| `odom_frame` | string | `odom` | odometry frame |
| `map_frame` | string | `map` | map frame |
| `base_frame` | string | `base_link` | robot base frame |
| `scan_topic` | string | `/scan` | LaserScan topic |
| `solver_plugin` | string | `solver_plugins::CeresSolver` | pose-graph solver |
| `ceres_linear_solver` | string | `SPARSE_NORMAL_CHOLESKY` | Ceres linear solver |
| `ceres_preconditioner` | string | `SCHUR_JACOBI` | Ceres preconditioner |
| `ceres_trust_strategy` | string | `LEVENBERG_MARQUARDT` | Ceres trust-region strategy |
| `ceres_dogleg_type` | string | `TRADITIONAL_DOGLEG` | Ceres dogleg type |
| `ceres_loss_function` | string | `None` | Ceres loss function |
| `throttle_scans` | int | `1` | process every Nth scan |
| `transform_publish_period` | double | `0.02` | map->odom publish period [s] |
| `map_update_interval` | double | `5.0` | occupancy grid publish period [s] |
| `resolution` | double | `0.05` | grid cell size [m] |
| `max_laser_range` | double | `10.0` | max range used for the map [m] |
| `minimum_time_interval` | double | `0.2` | min time between processed scans [s] |
| `transform_timeout` | double | `0.2` | TF lookup timeout [s] |
| `tf_buffer_duration` | double | `30.0` | TF buffer length [s] |
| `stack_size_to_use` | int | `40000000` | thread stack size [bytes] |
| `use_scan_matching` | bool | true | scan matching on/off |
| `use_scan_barycenter` | bool | true | use scan barycenter for distance |
| `minimum_travel_distance` | double | `0.5` | min travel before a new scan is added [m] |
| `minimum_travel_heading` | double | `0.5` | min rotation before a new scan is added [rad] |
| `scan_buffer_size` | int | `10` | scans kept in the local chain |
| `scan_buffer_maximum_scan_distance` | double | `10.0` | max distance in the local chain [m] |
| `link_match_minimum_response_fine` | double | `0.1` | min response to link scans |
| `link_scan_maximum_distance` | double | `1.5` | max distance to link scans [m] |
| `loop_search_maximum_distance` | double | `3.0` | loop closure search radius [m] |
| `do_loop_closing` | bool | true | loop closure on/off |
| `loop_match_minimum_chain_size` | int | `10` | min chain size for a loop closure |
| `loop_match_maximum_variance_coarse` | double | `3.0` | max coarse variance for a loop closure |
| `loop_match_minimum_response_coarse` | double | `0.35` | min coarse response for a loop closure |
| `loop_match_minimum_response_fine` | double | `0.45` | min fine response for a loop closure |
| `correlation_search_space_dimension` | double | `0.5` | scan-match search window [m] |
| `correlation_search_space_resolution` | double | `0.01` | scan-match search resolution [m] |
| `correlation_search_space_smear_deviation` | double | `0.1` | scan-match smear deviation |
| `loop_search_space_dimension` | double | `8.0` | loop search window [m] |
| `loop_search_space_resolution` | double | `0.05` | loop search resolution [m] |
| `loop_search_space_smear_deviation` | double | `0.03` | loop search smear deviation |
| `distance_variance_penalty` | double | `0.5` | distance variance penalty |
| `angle_variance_penalty` | double | `1.0` | angle variance penalty |
| `fine_search_angle_offset` | double | `0.00349` | fine angular search range [rad] |
| `coarse_search_angle_offset` | double | `0.349` | coarse angular search range [rad] |
| `coarse_angle_resolution` | double | `0.0349` | coarse angular resolution [rad] |
| `minimum_angle_penalty` | double | `0.9` | min angle penalty |
| `minimum_distance_penalty` | double | `0.5` | min distance penalty |
| `use_response_expansion` | bool | true | expand search when response is low |

Not set here, so each version uses its own default: parameters that exist only in one version (for example `min_laser_range`, `use_map_saver` on ROS2).

## GMapping (ROS1 baseline) ↔ slam_toolbox

| GMapping | Value | slam_toolbox | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `base_frame` | `base_link` | `base_frame` | `base_link` | same frame |
| `odom_frame` | `odom` | `odom_frame` | `odom` | same frame |
| `map_frame` | `map` | `map_frame` | `map` | same frame |
| `delta` | `0.05` | `resolution` | `0.05` | grid cell size [m] |
| `maxUrange` | `10.0` | `max_laser_range` | `10.0` | range used for mapping [m] |
| `map_update_interval` | `5.0` | `map_update_interval` | `5.0` | map publish period [s] |
| `linearUpdate` | `0.5` | `minimum_travel_distance` | `0.5` | travel before a scan is processed [m] |
| `angularUpdate` | `0.5` | `minimum_travel_heading` | `0.5` | rotation before a scan is processed [rad] |
| `transform_publish_period` | `0.02` | `transform_publish_period` | `0.02` | map->odom publish period [s] |

### GMapping-only parameters

| Parameter | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `maxRange` | `12.0` | sensor max range; beams beyond it are free space [m] |
| `temporalUpdate` | `-1.0` | process a scan after this time even without motion (-1 = off) [s] |
| `particles` | `30` | particle count of the Rao-Blackwellized filter |
| `resampleThreshold` | `0.5` | Neff threshold for resampling |
| `minimumScore` | `0.0` | min scan-match score to accept a pose |
| `srr` | `0.1` | odometry error: translation from translation |
| `srt` | `0.2` | odometry error: translation from rotation |
| `str` | `0.1` | odometry error: rotation from translation |
| `stt` | `0.2` | odometry error: rotation from rotation |
| `xmin` | `-20.0` | initial map extent [m] |
| `ymin` | `-20.0` | initial map extent [m] |
| `xmax` | `20.0` | initial map extent [m] |
| `ymax` | `20.0` | initial map extent [m] |

## Removed in v0.2: `ros1/params/mapping.yaml`

This v0.1.0 file was never loaded by the ROS1 launch file, and its keys are not GMapping parameters.

| Old key | GMapping parameter | slam_toolbox parameter |
|---|---|---|
| `map_resolution` | `delta` | `resolution` |
| `max_range` | `maxUrange` | `max_laser_range` |
| `update_rate` | `map_update_interval (period, not rate)` | `map_update_interval` |
